text_block_list.text:
"Before the start of the Kyoto Daishoten, 
an unsettling tension drifted through the 
crowd."

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
A news article mentioned that Satono 
Diamond might not be in the best shape, 
but I wonder how she'll do today...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Even the reporters could tell something 
was off with her running... Doesn't that 
sound pretty serious...?

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Wonder what happened...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Whew...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yes... As expected, I'm feeling a 
little nervous today...

Satono Diamond's running had gradually 
been recovering with adjustments. However, 
this would be her first time racing since 
then.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...I think I'll be fine today.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Because running with Kita-chan helped me 
remember...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
That feeling of looking nowhere but 
straight ahead as you run.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
That I was running solely with the desire 
to catch up.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: "I had mistaken the very reason I run."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I used to consider it my duty to run 
like a "distinguished Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I believed I had to show a performance 
that surpassed McQueen-san, one that 
proved I could take on the world...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: However, that was not the case.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
—I want to show everyone the realm of 
possibility.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Wanting to fulfill Satono's long-cherished 
dream. Wanting to surpass McQueen-san and 
the others. And wanting to contribute to 
the Umamusume world as a renowned racer.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Just like how I want to catch up to 
Kita-chan.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Everything is as I wish.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Not for anyone else. I run for my own 
desires.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Because I mistook that, I must have lost 
sight of the direction I should be heading 
in."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"I only needed to look straight ahead and 
run. Just as my heart desired."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
And running of my own free will is truly 
fun.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Running is fun. I was able to remember 
that feeling.

Now that you mention it, that's true. She 
did say she shoulders her family's wishes 
because it's what she herself wants to 
fulfill.
She runs because she herself desires it.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
That is why today, I will run with only my 
dream of becoming a 'renowned Umamusume' 
in my heart.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: —Run just like Satono Diamond should.
